name: Photodump
summary: Four photos of you from one photo, in four scenes of an aesthetic, like a feed photo dump, in one run (FLUX 3 Image Klein).

source.notes: apps/edit's pipeline four times over the same photo: four prompts (the aesthetic select writes all four, nodes 4 and pd_t2-4), four ReferenceMultiLatent and four samplers with the same seed, joined with ImageBatch into one SaveImage. The prompts follow apps/character's wording ("The same person as in <ref_image_0>, <scene>"): with "A candid phone photo of the same person" the first run (20261026-002124-l40s) pasted the photo, same pose and framing, on four backgrounds.

inputs.label: Aesthetic
inputs.help: Four photos, one per scene of the aesthetic, all with the person from your photo.
